meta.title: Designer Mode
meta.description: A live UI canvas in the right sidebar: the agent builds and revises the interface until you mark the design done, with pencil-click element selection.

guide.title: Designer mode
guide.description: Live UI canvas with click-to-select element editing

ui.pencilOff: Pencil off: clicks pass through to the page
ui.finished: Design approved — the agent may now implement it in the project.
ui.empty: No design yet. Ask the agent for the first screen.
ui.ask: What should change about this element?
ui.hint: Describe a change, or ask for the next screen…
